item.tib: sdom pa gsum gyi bka' yig bon gyi gaN+Di'i sgra dbyangs
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni dpal ldan gong rgyal dgon gyi gtsug lag khang bshad sgrab bstan 'phel gling du dbyar gnas kyi skabs dge bskos nas sdom gsum gyi bslab bya mdor bsdus re gleng nas dran gso'i bgyid rgyuramakhan chen bla ma mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhal snga nas nan tan gyis gsungs bskul ngor rim 'gyangs su lus pa phyis su g.yu rong smon grol gling gi gtsug lag khang du gshen gyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa bskal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas 'phral du bris pa'o//
